'''Phontos''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]]. He worked out of [[The Grill]], located in [[Shulell City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]]. Phontos was on good terms with a number of the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who frequented [[Shulell City spaceport]], and his office maintained a tropical [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="PSG" />
